top_jobs.job: When a bold idea gets a yes or a bet has run for weeks, help me set its cost cap, stop rule and read date and read it against a group left out, so a big swing never quietly sinks the quarter
top_jobs.metric: spend to date on each live bet against its cap, and share of bets launched with a cap, stop rule, read date and comparison group on file

top_jobs.job: When a creator, ambassador or partner deal is up for a yes or a renewal, help me see the orders, new customers and cost per order it brought next to paid ads, so I renew only the ones that paid
top_jobs.metric: orders and new customers from each partner's code or link, 30 days, and cost per order against paid ads

top_jobs.job: When a launch has a story or press lands, help me pitch the right writers and turn the wave of visitors into orders and lasting links, so PR sells and keeps selling
top_jobs.metric: visits, orders and conversion rate from each press piece, 14 days

top_jobs.job: When a bad post spreads, a partner slips up, or we know a problem is coming, help me size it fast and reply first with a message I approved, so it stops in hours, not weeks
top_jobs.metric: hours from a negative spike to an approved public reply

top_jobs.job: When the top 2 percent of buyers drive a large share of profit, help me treat them as insiders with quiet perks and prove it against similar buyers left out, so we keep and grow them
top_jobs.metric: repeat purchase rate of the inner circle against similar buyers left out, 90 days

jobs.job: Write a bet card before any money moves: the category habit it breaks, the most it can cost, the stop rule, the read date, the named metric and a group left out, signed by the founder
jobs.trigger: before any bet, stunt, partnership or event gets money

inputs.need: the quarter's bet cap and cash floor
wild bet ideas and stop rule examples

steps: Name the habit in our category the bet breaks
Write the most it can cost in cash, product and team hours
Write the stop rule and the read date
Pick 1 metric and a left-out group of similar customers
Check it against past bets for a repeat
Founder signs; no card, no spend
jobs.output: a signed bet card with cap, stop rule, read date, metric and comparison group

watch.metric: share of bets launched with a cost cap, stop rule, read date and comparison group on file

jobs.drives: bets that cannot become a crisis

jobs.job: Set the quarter's total bet cap as a share of profit after ads, and show spend to date on each live bet against its cap every Monday
jobs.trigger: at quarter planning, then every Monday

inputs.need: profit after ads, last quarter and plan
spend per bet: ads, product, fees, hours

steps: Founder sets the cap, for example 5 percent of the quarter's profit after ads
Log every dollar and product unit to its bet
Show each bet's spend against its own cap and the total against the quarter cap
Flag any bet past 80 percent of its cap
Stop or re-sign any bet past its cap
jobs.output: a Monday bet table: spend against cap per bet and in total

watch.metric: total bet spend this quarter as a share of profit after ads

jobs.drives: cash kept safe from runaway bets

jobs.job: At each bet's read date, compare the bet group with the left-out group on the named metric, and call scale in steps, stop or rerun, testing any borrowed stunt on a small group first
jobs.trigger: at each bet's read date

inputs.need: orders, gross profit and repeat rate per group

steps: Pull the named metric for both groups
Compute the gain per customer and the gross profit per customer reached
Call scale to the next step, stop or rerun
For a scale, set the next step size and its check
Write the result and 1 lesson in the ledger
jobs.output: a bet read with the call, the next step size, and a lesson on file

watch.metric: gain on the bet's named metric against the left-out group

jobs.job: Launch the next new product as a pre-order or a 200 unit drop with a sales target set before launch, and order full stock only if the target is hit
jobs.trigger: for every new product before the first full stock order

inputs.need: the product, price and landed cost
supplier minimum order and lead time

steps: Set the target and the window, for example 300 pre-orders in 14 days
Build the pre-order page with honest ship dates
Send to the list and the top buyers first
Count pre-orders daily against target
Order full stock, a smaller run, or refund and drop
jobs.output: a pre-order result against target and a stock decision

watch.metric: pre-orders or drop sales against the target set before launch

jobs.drives: cash tied up in stock that does not sell

jobs.job: Run a 90 day capped test on TikTok Shop or Amazon with 3 hero products, a price floor after fees, and a stop rule on profit per order
jobs.trigger: once, when the founder wants a new channel; read at 30, 60 and 90 days

inputs.need: channel fees, shipping and ad costs
a seller account on the channel
inputs.from: TikTok Shop or Amazon Seller Central

steps: Pick 3 hero products and set the price floor after fees
Set up listings with the best images and review proof
Cap spend and stock for 90 days
Read orders and profit per order at 30, 60 and 90 days
Scale, hold or close on the stop rule
jobs.output: a 90 day channel test with profit per order and a call

watch.metric: orders and profit per order in the test channel

jobs.drives: new revenue without a new business

jobs.job: Shortlist 20 creators whose followers match our best buyers by age, gender and region, check their past brand deals and comments, and send product to the top 10 with a code each
jobs.trigger: monthly, and before each launch

inputs.need: our best segment by age, gender, placement and region

steps: Pull the segment that buys at the lowest cost per new customer
Find 20 creators whose audience matches it
Check past brand deals, comment quality and fake follower share
Send product to the top 10 with a unique code and no tight script
Log each in the roster with cost and date
jobs.output: a seeded list of 10 creators with codes, costs and match notes

watch.metric: orders per creator code within 30 days, and product cost per order

jobs.job: Run each creator's best post as a partnership ad through their handle at $50 a day for 7 days, and rank creators by cost per new customer against our own best ads
jobs.trigger: after each creator posts

inputs.need: our best ads' cost per new customer
the media buyer to launch in Ads Manager (ecomOS reads only)

steps: Get written rights and partnership ad access from each creator
Media buyer launches the best post at $50 a day for 7 days
Pull cost per new customer, hold rate and segment
Rank creators against our own best ads
Scale the top 2, renew or end the rest
jobs.output: a creator rank by cost per new customer with a scale list

watch.metric: cost per new customer from partnership ads against our own ads

jobs.job: Close each creator deal, ambassador term or collab with a 1 page read: orders, new customers, cost per order and product cost next to paid ads, then renew, renegotiate or end
jobs.trigger: at the end of each deal or term

inputs.need: orders by the partner's code or link

steps: Pull orders and new customers for 30 days by code and link
Total the deal cost
Compare cost per order with paid ads
Write renew, renegotiate or end
Update the roster and the do-not-work-with list
jobs.output: a partner read with cost per order and a call

watch.metric: orders and new customers from the partner's code or link, and cost per order

jobs.job: Vet every partner, creator or licensee before signing: past posts, brand clashes, audience match and fake follower share, filed as pass or flag
jobs.trigger: before any contract
steps: Read 12 months of posts for clashes with our values and category
Check audience match and fake follower share
Check news and reviews for problems
File pass or flag with the reason
Add an exit clause for flags that still go ahead
jobs.output: a vetting note per partner with pass or flag

watch.metric: partners approved with an open reputation flag

jobs.job: Run the ambassador program on a weekly routine: tasks sent Monday, posts checked by Wednesday, orders per code counted Friday
jobs.trigger: every week while the program runs
steps: Send each ambassador 1 task on Monday
Check posts against voice and claims by Wednesday
Count orders per code on Friday
Drop anyone with 0 orders for 8 weeks
jobs.output: a weekly ambassador sheet: tasks, posts checked, orders per code

watch.metric: orders from ambassador codes per month, and posts waiting past the review deadline

jobs.job: Find the angle a journalist would run for the next launch (data, founder story, trend or stunt), and build a list of 25 writers who covered that topic in the last 90 days
jobs.trigger: 6 weeks before a launch or news

inputs.need: the launch and what is new about it
our own data a writer could use, like survey or order trends

steps: Write 3 angles that are news, not ads
Pick 1 with our own data behind it
Find 25 writers who covered the topic in 90 days
Write a 5 line pitch per writer group
Track replies per pitch
jobs.output: an angle, a checked list of 25 writers, and pitches with reply tracking

watch.metric: reply rate on pitches, per story

jobs.job: Before a press piece or planned spike lands, check stock on the featured product, a matching landing page, email capture and a retargeting audience, all within 24 hours
jobs.trigger: the day a piece is confirmed, and within 2 hours of a viral post

inputs.need: the piece or post and what it promises
audience for visitors from the piece

steps: Check stock covers 3x a normal week of the featured product
Point the link to a page that matches the story
Turn on email capture for the visitors
Ask the media buyer to build a retargeting audience
Watch orders hourly for 72 hours
jobs.output: a 24 hour readiness check passed, and hourly orders for 72 hours

watch.metric: orders in the 72 hours after a spike against a normal 72 hours

jobs.job: Count visits, orders, sign-ups and new linking sites from each press placement over 14 days and over the retainer term, before the PR agency renews
jobs.trigger: 14 days after each placement, and 30 days before the retainer renews

inputs.need: visits and orders by referring site

steps: List placements with dates
Pull visits, orders and sign-ups from each for 14 days
Pull new links from each
Total cost per order over the term
Renew, renegotiate or end on the numbers
jobs.output: a placement table and a renewal call with cost per order

watch.metric: visits, new linking sites and orders from each placement

jobs.job: Ask every outlet that names us without a link to add one, and check 30 days later whether AI answers and search now name us for the topic
jobs.trigger: within 7 days of each mention, and 30 days after

inputs.need: mentions of the brand without a link
search results and AI answers for the topic

steps: List new mentions and whether each links to us
Send a short thank you with the link request
Log each outcome
30 days later, check AI answers and search for the topic
jobs.output: linked mentions gained and a before and after on AI answers

watch.metric: new sites mentioning or linking to the brand

jobs.drives: buyers from search and AI answers for a year

jobs.job: Watch reviews, social mentions and tickets for a spike in a negative theme, size it within 2 hours (posts, reach, orders at risk), and draft a reply for the founder to approve
jobs.trigger: hourly check; alert when a negative theme doubles its daily average

inputs.need: new reviews with rating and text

steps: Group new reviews, tickets and mentions by theme
Alert when a negative theme doubles
Size it: posts, reach, orders from affected customers
Draft a reply and a fix in our voice
Founder approves; post and reply to each customer
Log hours from spike to reply
jobs.output: an alert, a size estimate, and an approved reply within hours

watch.metric: hours from a negative spike to an approved public reply

jobs.job: When a recall, delay or price rise is known, draft the customer email, the FAQ line and the post before customers find out, and send within 48 hours
jobs.trigger: the day the team knows
steps: List affected customers and orders
Draft the email, FAQ line, post and support macro
Founder approves
Send to affected customers first, then post
Track tickets and refunds for 14 days
jobs.output: an approved message set sent within 48 hours, with tickets tracked

watch.metric: days from knowing a problem to telling affected customers

jobs.job: Watch each partner's and ambassador's public posts daily, and keep a written exit clause and a holding statement ready for each
jobs.trigger: daily while any partner is live
steps: List live partners and their handles
Scan daily for clashes or news
Keep a holding statement per partner
On a flag, pause ads through their handle and decide within 24 hours
jobs.output: a daily partner watch with a holding statement per partner

watch.metric: hours from a partner's public problem to our response

jobs.job: Pick the top 2 percent of buyers by profit and recency, leave out anyone with an open complaint, send half a personal letter from the founder with private early access, and keep the other half as the comparison
jobs.trigger: quarterly

inputs.need: customers ranked by profit and recency
the founder's letter in their voice
printing and mailing, or a handwritten note service

steps: Rank customers and take the top 2 percent
Drop anyone with an open ticket or a recent bad review
Split at random into letter and no letter
Send the letter with a private link and no discount code on the envelope
Keep it quiet: no public post about the program
Compare repeat rate and profit per customer after 90 days
jobs.output: a VIP letter test: who got what, and repeat rate against the comparison group

watch.metric: repeat orders, mailed group against not mailed

jobs.job: Give the inner circle first access to the next drop through a private link 48 hours early, and compare their repeat rate and referrals with similar buyers left out after 90 days
jobs.trigger: before each drop or launch
steps: Set aside stock for the inner circle
Send the private link 48 hours early
Count orders and referrals from the link
Compare with left-out buyers at 90 days
jobs.output: an inner circle read: orders, referrals and repeat rate against left-out buyers

watch.metric: repeat purchase rate of the inner circle against similar buyers left out

jobs.job: Find a reason worth telling a friend in the words happy buyers use in reviews, give top buyers a referral link with a product reward, and count orders per link
jobs.trigger: once to set up, then monthly

inputs.need: a referral app or link tracking

steps: Pull the phrases happy buyers repeat most
Write the ask in those words
Send top buyers a link with a product reward, not a discount
Count orders and new customers per link monthly
jobs.output: a referral ask in customers' words and orders per link

watch.metric: share of orders from a referral code or link

new_enablers.name: Bet ledger
new_enablers.what: Every bold bet with its card (habit broken, cost cap, stop rule, read date, metric, left-out group), spend to date against its cap and the quarter cap, the read, and one lesson when it closes.
powers: bets that cannot sink the quarter

new_enablers.name: Press tracker
new_enablers.what: Stories and angles, the writer list with a checked beat, pitches and replies, placements, and visits, orders, sign-ups and links from each piece. Holds the 24 hour readiness check for a spike.

new_enablers.name: Mention and reputation watch
new_enablers.what: Watches reviews, tickets and public posts about the brand and its partners, groups them by theme, alerts when a negative theme spikes, and keeps holding statements and approved replies.
powers: partner problems caught in a day
